# CapFetch

> Free short video caption extractor for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Extract transcripts, analyze viral content, and optimize your short form video strategy. No sign-up required.

## Core Tools
- [TikTok Caption Extractor](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-caption-extractor): Extract captions and transcripts from TikTok videos
- [TikTok Subtitle Extractor](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-subtitle-extractor): Pull subtitles from TikTok videos
- [TikTok Transcript Generator](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-transcript-generator): Generate full transcripts from TikTok
- [TikTok Video to Text](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-video-to-text): Convert TikTok video speech to text
- [TikTok Text Extractor](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-text-extractor): Extract all text from TikTok videos
- [TikTok Caption Downloader](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-caption-downloader): Download TikTok captions as text files
- [TikTok Caption Rewriter](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-caption-rewriter): Rewrite and repurpose TikTok captions
- [TikTok Viral Analyzer](https://capfetch.com/tiktok-viral-analyzer): Analyze what makes TikTok captions go viral
- [Reels Caption Extractor](https://capfetch.com/reels-caption-extractor): Extract captions from Instagram Reels
- [Reels Transcript Generator](https://capfetch.com/reels-transcript-generator): Generate transcripts from Instagram Reels
- [Reels Video to Text](https://capfetch.com/reels-video-to-text): Convert Reels videos to text
- [Reels Caption Downloader](https://capfetch.com/reels-caption-downloader): Download Reels captions
- [Shorts Transcript Extractor](https://capfetch.com/shorts-transcript-extractor): Extract transcripts from YouTube Shorts
- [Shorts Transcript Downloader](https://capfetch.com/shorts-transcript-downloader): Download YouTube Shorts transcripts
- [Shorts Video to Text](https://capfetch.com/shorts-video-to-text): Convert YouTube Shorts to text
